 1            Plaintiff Eric Raymond (“Plaintiff”), on behalf of all others similarly situated, by and
 2   through his undersigned counsel, brings this Class Action Complaint against Serviceaide, Inc.
 3   (“Serviceaide” or “Defendant”). Plaintiff alleges the following upon information and belief based
 4   on and the investigation of counsel, except as to those allegations that specifically pertain to
 5   Plaintiff, which are alleged upon personal knowledge.
 6                                                 INTRODUCTION
 7            1.       Plaintiff brings this class action lawsuit on behalf of all persons who entrusted
 8   Defendant with sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (“PII”) 1 and Protected Health
 9   Information (“PHI”) (collectively “Private Information”) that was impacted in a data breach that
10   Defendant publicly disclosed on May 9, 2025 (the “Data Breach” or the “Breach”).
11            2.       Plaintiff’s claims arise from Defendant’s failure to properly secure and safeguard
12   Private Information that was entrusted to it, and its accompanying responsibility to store and
13   transfer that information.
14            3.       Defendant is a software development company that specializes in agentic AI
15   solutions for workflow automation, IT support, and cross-team integration and is the provider of
16   information technology support management services to Catholic Health. Defendant is
17   headquartered in San Jose, California. 2
18            4.       As part of their operations, Defendant collects, maintains, and stores highly
19   sensitive Private Information belonging to Catholic Health’s patients.
20            5.       Defendant had numerous statutory, regulatory, contractual, and common law
21   duties and obligations, including those based on its affirmative representations to Plaintiff and
22   Class Members, to keep their Private Information confidential, safe, secure, and protected from
23   unauthorized disclosure or access.
24
25

19   take measures to protect themselves.
